title: Weight of the linear dual
statement: Fix primes $p$ and $\ell\ne p$, an integer $a\ge1$, $q=p^a$, $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, an algebraic closure $k$ of $k_0$, an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and an isomorphism $\iota:\Qlb\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf C$. Let $Y_0$ be a finite-type $k_0$-scheme and put $Y=Y_0\times_{k_0}k$. Let $\mathcal F$ be a lisse finite-rank $\Qlb$-Weil sheaf [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], and let $w\in\mathbf R$. If $\mathcal F$ is punctually $\iota$-pure of weight $w$ [def-weil-punctual-weights], then its linear dual $\mathcal F^\vee=\mathcal Hom_{\Qlb}(\mathcal F,\Qlb_Y)$, with the contragredient Weil structure of [def-real-weil-representation-operations], is punctually $\iota$-pure of weight $-w$.

proof.text: Fix any closed point $y$ and geometric point $\bar y$ over it, and put $V=\mathcal F_{\bar y}$ and $A=F_{y,\mathcal F}$. By [lem-tw-dual-stalk-frobenius], $\mathcal F^\vee$ is a constructible $\Qlb$-Weil sheaf, so [def-weil-punctual-weights] applies to it, and this comparison identifies the Frobenius of $(\mathcal F^\vee)_{\bar y}$ with $(A^{-1})^*$ on $V^\vee$. Here $V$ is finite-dimensional and $A$ is invertible, as specified by this comparison. The dual clause of [p-linear-spectra] therefore gives every eigenvalue $\beta$ of the dual stalk as $\beta=\alpha^{-1}$ for an eigenvalue $\alpha$ of $A$. Also $\alpha\ne0$: if $Av=0v$ for a nonzero eigenvector, applying $A^{-1}$ gives $v=0$, a contradiction.

source.place: Proof, first sentence; expanded using the complex absolute-value definition of punctual purity

proof.text:
For the eigenvalue $\alpha$ just obtained, punctual purity [def-weil-punctual-weights] says $|\iota(\alpha)|=q_y^{w/2}$, where $q_y=\#\kappa(y)>0$. Since $\iota$ is a field isomorphism and $\alpha\ne0$,
$$
 |\iota(\beta)|=|\iota(\alpha^{-1})|=|\iota(\alpha)^{-1}|=|\iota(\alpha)|^{-1}=(q_y^{w/2})^{-1}=q_y^{(-w)/2}.
$$
The last equality is the elementary exponent identity for a positive real base. This holds for every dual eigenvalue at every closed point, so, $\mathcal F^\vee$ being a constructible $\Qlb$-Weil sheaf by step 1, it is exactly punctual $\iota$-purity of weight $-w$ in [def-weil-punctual-weights].
